intro: Give each channel the frame it expects without rebuilding the product. Open a channel, check the table, then download and upload the file yourself.

faq.q: Which channel should I make a file for first?
faq.a: Start with the channel that already gets your orders. Make that frame, post it, then make a second frame from the same photo if you sell somewhere else too.

faq.q: Can one vertical clip run in more than one full-screen placement?
faq.a: A 9:16 clip is the frame those full-screen placements share. You still export it once per job and upload it yourself in each ad account. Check each channel's current file rules before you launch.

faq.q: What frame should a feed still use?
faq.a: Use a square still. Photos from this tool are square. It does not export a 4:5 still, or a 4:3 or 3:4 still. If the feed wants 4:5, crop the square file in your editor, then upload it.

faq.q: How long can a clip be?
faq.a: 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Credits are 24, 40, 60, and 120. The cost is shown before you start, and a failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: What should I make for a marketplace listing?
faq.a: Lead with a square still on a plain background for the main image, then add a detail or lifestyle still. A clip is optional and usually sits beside the gallery, not in the main-image slot.

faq.q: What should a store gallery use?
faq.a: Keep gallery stills square so the grid lines up. Add a short clip when motion explains the product better than another still.

faq.q: Do you post the file to my ad account?
faq.a: No. You download the file and upload it yourself. Add the headline, the price, and any licensed music in your editor first.

faq.q: Can one file run on every channel unchanged?
faq.a: The product can stay the same. The frame usually should not. A square listing still and a 9:16 clip are two jobs from one photo.

faq.q: How do I keep the product off the channel's buttons?
faq.a: Leave space around the product in a 9:16 clip, and check the file on a phone before you pay for traffic. The exact button layout changes by channel.

faq.q: Do I need a separate clip for every channel?
faq.a: Make a separate file when the frame changes. Two channels that both take 9:16 can use the same download if their file rules match.

faq.q: Can I use the download in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Finished files can be used commercially and have no watermark. You are responsible for the claims and the music you add.
Add them after download in your editor or in the ad account. This tool does not put captions on the file.
